theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks holds the top momentum rank, exhibits full breadth (1.0) and remains eligible under the validated absolute-trend gate, which historically curtails drawdowns. Crowding (z=1.2) is a caution to size down, not to fade; a controlled overweight respects the trend strength while acknowledging the extended positioning.
